subject: general
question: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom: Out and about
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **Active and socializing**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Out and about"** means being active and engaging in social or outdoor activities, rather than staying indoors. (सक्रिय और सामाजिक रूप से बाहर रहना) • **Example: **After recovering from her illness, she was happy to be out and about again. • **Correct word:** Active and socializing (सक्रिय और सामाजिक रूप से सक्रिय रहना) • **Example: **He enjoys being out and about, meeting new people and exploring the city. • Therefore, the correct answer is: **Active and socializing**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **At home resting** (घर पर आराम करना): Refers to staying at home and taking rest, not being active outdoors. • **Example:** After a long day at work, she spent the evening at home resting. • **Doing errands** (काम-काज करना): Refers to completing small tasks or chores, usually outside the home. • **Example:** She spent the morning doing errands like grocery shopping and going to the bank. • **Traveling to distant places** (दूरस्थ स्थानों की यात्रा करना): Refers to going on long trips or journeys to faraway locations. • **Example:** He loves traveling to distant places and exploring different cultures. 3d:Ta6e, The correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. Active**.
